AccessTokenRead.description:
An access token for `Authorization: Bearer`, valid 15 minutes (ADR-006).

The SPA keeps it in memory only; the refresh token comes as a cookie.
AccessTokenRead.title: AccessTokenRead

DefaultMatchFormat.description:
The match format a league's new tournaments start with (FR-011, BR-120).

Not BO2: only group phases of leagues with draws can play it (BR-121), so a
default that a knockout cannot take is never copied (DATA-MODEL §4.2).
DefaultMatchFormat.title: DefaultMatchFormat

DrawTarget.description: What "draw again" draws: the pairs (DYP, Doubles) or the seeds (shuffle).
DrawTarget.title: DrawTarget

DrawWrite.description: A new draw, with the draw counter the screen showed (ADR-008, ADR-010).
DrawWrite.title: DrawWrite

DypHalf.description: Where a DYP player stands before the draw (DATA-MODEL `dyp_halves.half`).
DypHalf.title: DypHalf

EntryKind.description: An entry is one player or a pair (glossary "Entry", BR-030).
EntryKind.title: EntryKind

EntryRead.description:
An entry: one player, or a pair with its better-ranked player first.

A DYP pair names its top-half player first. `seed` is null in Monster DYP.
EntryRead.title: EntryRead

EntryStage.description: Which phase an entry plays: the first (`main`) or a later knockout (D4).
EntryStage.title: EntryStage

ErrorCode.description: Every stable error code of the API (ADR-008).
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

ErrorResponse.description: The body of every error response (ADR-008).
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

GroupPhase.description:
The group phase chosen in setup, or none (FR-031).

Monster DYP always plays `monster_dyp`, and the other types never do.
GroupPhase.title: GroupPhase

HalvesMethod.description: How a DYP tournament's halves are made (FR-033, BR-032).
HalvesMethod.title: HalvesMethod

HalvesWrite.description:
How a DYP tournament's halves are made (FR-033, BR-032).

`ranking` ignores `halves`. `by_hand` sets them as the target state; a
picked player without a row has no half yet.
HalvesWrite.title: HalvesWrite

KnockoutMatchFormat.description: A match format a knockout and its final can play: never BO2 (BR-121).
KnockoutMatchFormat.title: KnockoutMatchFormat

Language.description: The UI language an account remembers (FR-081, DATA-MODEL §4.1).
Language.title: Language

LeagueCreate.description: A new league; `id` is generated by the client (ADR-008).
LeagueCreate.title: LeagueCreate

LeagueRead.description:
A league as its organizer sees it, with every season, oldest first.

`share_token` is the secret of the league's share link (FR-070, FR-071).
LeagueRead.title: LeagueRead

LeagueSummary.description: A league in the organizer's list (FR-007).
LeagueSummary.title: LeagueSummary

LeagueUpdate.description:
League settings to change (FR-011); a field left out or null stays as it is.

Each value is the target state, so repeating the request changes nothing
(ADR-008). The placement points table belongs to the season: see
`set_placement_points`.
LeagueUpdate.title: LeagueUpdate

LoginRequest.description: An email and a password; `throttle_login` reads it too (ADR-006).
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

MatchFormat.description: Best of how many games a match is (BR-120); BO2 only in group phases (BR-121).
MatchFormat.title: MatchFormat

OrganizerRead.description: An account in the admin's list.
OrganizerRead.title: OrganizerRead

PairsWrite.description:
A Doubles tournament's pairs, the target state (FR-033, BR-003, BR-030).

No player twice (`given_twice`); picked players left out have no partner yet.
PairsWrite.title: PairsWrite

PasswordChange.description: The current password and the new one (FR-004).
PasswordChange.title: PasswordChange

PasswordReset.description: A temporary password the admin chose, or null to have one generated.
PasswordReset.title: PasswordReset

PasswordResetRead.description: The generated temporary password, shown once; null if the admin chose one.
PasswordResetRead.title: PasswordResetRead

PhaseFormat.description: How a phase is played: one of the group formats, or the knockout's.
PhaseFormat.title: PhaseFormat

PhaseKind.description: A phase is a group phase or a knockout (DATA-MODEL §4.3, D9).
PhaseKind.title: PhaseKind

PlacementPointsUpdate.description: The whole placement points table, first place first (FR-011).
PlacementPointsUpdate.title: PlacementPointsUpdate

PlayerCreate.description: A name to add to the league's player list (FR-012).
PlayerCreate.title: PlayerCreate

PlayerRead.description: A player of a league; `removed_at` is null while they are on the list.
PlayerRead.title: PlayerRead

PlayerRemoval.description: Whether the player is removed from the list, the target state (BR-002).
PlayerRemoval.title: PlayerRemoval

PlayerRename.description: A player's new name, the target state (FR-012, ADR-008).
PlayerRename.title: PlayerRename

PlayersWrite.description: The players picked for the tournament, the target state (FR-032).
PlayersWrite.title: PlayersWrite

ProfileUpdate.description: The fields to change; a field left out or null stays as it is.
ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate

RankingRow.description: A player's place in the league ranking this tournament uses (BR-020).
RankingRow.title: RankingRow

SeasonRead.description: A season; `name` is null while it has the default name (FR-020).
SeasonRead.title: SeasonRead

SeasonRename.description: A season's new name; null restores the default "Season <number>" (FR-020).
SeasonRename.title: SeasonRename

SeasonStart.description: Start the next season; the active season's number as the client saw it.
SeasonStart.title: SeasonStart

SeasonState.description: Whether a season is the league's active one (FR-021, DATA-MODEL §4.2).
SeasonState.title: SeasonState

SeedOrderWrite.description: Every main entry, seed 1 first: the full order, never a move (ADR-008).
SeedOrderWrite.title: SeedOrderWrite

SeedingMethod.description: How the first phase is seeded (FR-034, BR-021, BR-022).
SeedingMethod.title: SeedingMethod

SeedingWrite.description: Seed by league ranking or by random shuffle (FR-034, BR-021, BR-022).
SeedingWrite.title: SeedingWrite

SignUpRequest.description: A new account and the instance's sign-up code (FR-001); the throttle reads it.
SignUpRequest.title: SignUpRequest

SignupCodeRead.description: The sign-up code, which the admin may see and share; null: sign-up is closed.
SignupCodeRead.title: SignupCodeRead

SignupCodeUpdate.description: The new code, or null to close sign-up (FR-005).
SignupCodeUpdate.title: SignupCodeUpdate

TournamentCreate.description:
A new tournament in the league's active season (FR-030).

`id` is a UUIDv7 made by the client; a repeat gets the same tournament back
(ADR-008). A setting left out or null takes the league's default: goals per
game, the number of fields and the match format of the phase (FR-011); one
round robin leg, no sit-out points (FR-039) and no third-place match.
TournamentCreate.title: TournamentCreate

TournamentFormatRead.description: The format as stored; settings that do not apply are null (FR-031).
TournamentFormatRead.title: TournamentFormatRead

TournamentFormatWrite.description:
The whole format of a tournament in setup, the target state (FR-030, FR-031).

With a group phase (`round_robin`, `swiss`, `monster_dyp`) its settings are
given and the knockout's are null: a knockout after a group phase is set up
when it starts (FR-045). With `none` the knockout's settings are given and
the group phase's are null. `round_robin_legs` is only for a round robin.
A setting that does not apply is 422 `validation_failed` with
`setting_not_applicable`; one that applies and is missing, `setting_missing`.
TournamentFormatWrite.title: TournamentFormatWrite

TournamentProgress.description: How far a running tournament is: rounds and matches with results.
TournamentProgress.title: TournamentProgress

TournamentSetupRead.description:
What the setup screens show (FR-030 to FR-034).

`draw_counter` goes back in "draw again" (ADR-008). `player_ids` are the
picked players in league-ranking order; `ranking` lists every player on the
league's list. `entries` are the main entries by seed.
TournamentSetupRead.title: TournamentSetupRead

TournamentState.description: Where a tournament is in its life (ADR-009, DATA-MODEL §4.3).
TournamentState.title: TournamentState

TournamentSummary.description:
A tournament in its season's list (screen 1).

`player_count` counts the picked players in setup, and the players in the
entries afterwards. `current_phase_id` and `progress` are null, and
`winner_player_ids` too, until the tournament is generated and finished.
TournamentSummary.title: TournamentSummary

get.description: Every account by email, admins included (ADR-007); not cached.

post.description:
Give an organizer a temporary password (FR-006, ADR-006).

Every login of the account is revoked and its next login must choose a new
password. With no `temporary_password` a random one is generated and returned
once. 422 `own_account` for the admin's own account, 422 `admin_target` for
another admin's (the CLI handles admins); 404 `user_not_found`.

get.description: The current sign-up code, or null while sign-up is closed (FR-005).

put.description:
Set or change the code, or close sign-up with null (FR-005).

Existing accounts are not affected. The action is recorded without the code.

post.description: Make a random code, store it and return it (FR-005).

Log in with email and password and start a login on this device.

A wrong password and an unknown email get the same 401. After repeated
failures, an attempt within a growing waiting period gets 429 with
`Retry-After`; nothing is locked.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next attempt is checked.

post.description: End this device's login and remove the cookie; repeating it is harmless.

Change the password and log out every other device (FR-004, ADR-006).

Works while an admin reset requires a new password, and then ends that
requirement. The login this call came from stays. 422 `wrong_password` is a
wrong current password; 422 `password_unchanged` a new one equal to it. The
current password is checked on the login's budget: after repeated failures,
here or at login, an attempt within a growing waiting period gets 429 with
`Retry-After`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next attempt is checked.

post.description:
Exchange the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new cookie.

A 401 means: log in again.

Create an organizer's account with the instance's sign-up code, logged in.

422 `invalid_signup_code` means a wrong code or closed sign-up; 422
`email_taken` an email that has an account, in any letter case. After
repeated failures an attempt within a growing waiting period gets 429 with
`Retry-After`. The tokens are those of a login.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next attempt is checked.

get.description: List the organizer's own leagues, oldest first (FR-007).

post.description:
Create a league with its Season 1, or return it again on a repeat (FR-010).

An id of another organizer's league, or a repeat racing its first attempt,
is 409: reload.

delete.description:
Delete the league with all its seasons (FR-013).

The UI asks for confirmation first. A repeated delete gets 404, which means
the league is already gone.

get.description: Return one of the organizer's leagues; another organizer's is 404.

patch.description: Change the league's settings (FR-011); allowed in any season (BR-011).

get.description:
List the league's players in the order they were added (FR-012).

Removed players come only with `include_removed=true`. Players belong to the
league, so closed seasons need nothing special.

post.description:
Add a player to the league (FR-012).

A name that another player has, in any case, is 422 `player_name_taken`
with the holder's `player_id`, `name` and `removed` (BR-001). When the
holder is removed, the UI asks whether it is the same person and restores
them (ADR-002). A parallel add of the same name that wins the race to the
unique index makes this one 409 `player_name_taken`: reload. A league holds at
most 500 players, removed ones included: more is 422 `player_limit_reached`.

put.description:
Rename a player; the new name shows in past results too (FR-012).

422 `player_name_taken` as for an add, 409 for the race. A removed player can
be renamed too, and the new name must be free as well (BR-011).

Remove a player from the list, or restore them (FR-012, BR-002).

A removal keeps the player, their name and their history; a restored player
is the same player. Both are target states, so repeating one changes nothing.

post.description:
Close the active season and start the next one (FR-021).

409 `season_number_changed`, with the active season's `current_number`,
when `expected_current_number` is stale, for example on a repeat: reload.

put.description: Rename a season, closed ones too (FR-020, BR-011).

Replace the active season's placement points table (FR-011, BR-012).

A closed season keeps its table: 409 `season_closed`, reload (BR-011). A
table with a place worth more than the place above it is 422
`validation_failed` with the error type `placement_points_increase` and the
`place`.

get.description:
List a season's tournaments, newest date first; closed seasons too (FR-022).

Another league's season is 404 `season_not_found`.

post.description:
Create a tournament in setup in the league's active season (FR-030).

A repeat gets the tournament back. An id that another tournament has, in
another season or with another type, is 409 `tournament_id_taken`. BO2 in a
league without draws is 422 `draws_not_allowed` (BR-121).

put.description:
Set the format of a tournament in setup (FR-030, FR-031, FR-039).

A new type keeps the picked players and makes the entries again. A started
tournament is 409 `tournament_not_in_setup`, as for every setup write.

get.description: Return a tournament's setup; another league's tournament is 404.

post.description:
Draw again: a new DYP draw, the rest of Doubles paired, or a shuffle (ADR-010).

A stale `expected_draw_counter` is 409 `draw_counter_changed` with the
current `draw_counter`. Shuffling seeds that come from the ranking is 409
`seeding_method_changed`. A DYP draw needs complete, valid halves: 422
`dyp_halves_incomplete`, `dyp_halves_unequal`, `too_many_left_out` or
`not_enough_players`. Pairing the rest of Doubles with fewer than two
unpaired players is 422 `nothing_to_pair`; nothing changes.

put.description:
Make a DYP tournament's halves by ranking or by hand (FR-033, BR-032).

Once every picked player has a half and the halves are equal, with at most
one left out, the partners are drawn (BR-033). 409 `player_not_picked` and
`tournament_type_changed` as for pairs.

Set a Doubles tournament's pairs (FR-033, BR-003, BR-030).

A player who is not picked is 409 `player_not_picked`; a tournament of
another type is 409 `tournament_type_changed`. Reload on both.

Pick the tournament's players (FR-032).

An id that is not a player of the league is 404 `player_not_found`; a
removed player is 409 `player_removed` (BR-002): reload. A change makes the entries
and draws again, and increments the draw counter (ADR-010).

Reorder the seeds by hand (FR-034).

An order that does not list exactly the current entries is 409
`seed_order_changed`: reload.

Seed by league ranking or by random shuffle (FR-034).

Monster DYP has no seeds: 409 `tournament_type_changed`.

get.description: The caller's account; works while a new password is required (ADR-006).

patch.description: Change the display name and the remembered language (FR-081).
